description: Replacement of existing timber frame windows and French doors with UPVC replacements
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & access statement,  101.EX, Location Plan, Block Plan, Received: 07/04/2021; window specification Received: 04/05/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The profile of the windows/doors hereby approved shall match those as existing and shall be retained permanently as such, unless prior written consent is obtained from the Local Planning Authority to any variation
